ऌ: ऌ ind. 1 The earth. --2 A mountain. --3 The mother of the gods. --4 The female nature. --5 A mystical letter. (N. B. No Sanskrit word begins with ऌ or ॡ, except some of the technical names of Pāṇini for tenses and moods; e. g. ऌङ् and ऌट्).
ऌङ्: ऌङ् A technical term used by Pāṇini to denote the Conditional mood or its terminations.
ऌट्: ऌट् A technical term used by Pāṇini to denote the Second or Simple Future or its terminations.
